errors.state: this connection link is unknown, used, expired or was opened in another browser; start the connection again
errors.reconnect_required: the OAuth connection needs someone to reconnect it in Credentials
errors.wrong_resource: the OAuth connection was made for another MCP server; reconnect it from this server
errors.not_oauth: the credential is not an OAuth connection
errors.create_tables: could not create the MCP OAuth tables
errors.workspace_required: a workspace is required to connect
errors.bad_url: {url} is not a usable http(s) URL
errors.resource_mismatch: the server publishes metadata for {resource}, which does not cover {url}
errors.no_authorization_server: the resource metadata at {url} names no authorization server
errors.not_oauth_server: {url} did not ask for OAuth (no 401 and no protected resource metadata)
errors.metadata_missing: the server pointed at {url} for its OAuth metadata, but nothing is there
errors.insecure_endpoint: {url} is not https; OAuth codes and tokens only go to https endpoints (or loopback)
errors.issuer_mismatch: the authorization server metadata names issuer {issuer}, not {url}
errors.server_metadata_missing: found no OAuth authorization server metadata for {issuer}
errors.endpoints_missing: the metadata of {issuer} lacks the authorization or token endpoint
errors.no_pkce: {issuer} does not support PKCE with S256
errors.metadata_decode: could not read the JSON at {url}
errors.client_required: {issuer} has no dynamic client registration: create an OAuth app there and fill in its client ID and secret
errors.registration_refused: the authorization server refused to register Thulu as a client ({status}): {detail}
errors.token_refused: the authorization server refused the token request ({status} {code}): {detail}
errors.denied: the authorization server did not grant access ({code}): {detail}
errors.save_flow: could not save the connection flow
errors.read_flow: could not read the connection flow
errors.refresh_failed: could not refresh the OAuth connection
errors.save_tokens: could not save the refreshed tokens
errors.bad_expires_in: the token endpoint sent an expires_in that is not a number: {value}

log.mark_failed_failed: mark OAuth connection {id} as needing a reconnect
